_comment: Burlington/Vermont artists. HAND-CURATED — this is the one file in the music pipeline a person owns, and it is deliberately not scraped. `threads` is how many distinct r/burlington or r/vermont threads named the artist, which is what ranked them; every entry had a verification URL at the time it was added. To add an artist: name, a link people can actually follow, and ideally one line in a local's voice. To remove one: delete the object. Nothing else reads a name that is not in here, which is what stops the build inventing bands.
_sources: Seven Days music section and the 2026 Seven Daysies

artists.name: Rough Francis
artists.why: The most-recommended band in a decade of threads. The members are sons of Death — yes, that Death.

artists.name: Cooked
artists.why: The name that ends every “is there even a scene here” argument.

artists.name: Greg Freeman
artists.why: “If Greg Freeman has 0 fans I'm not on this earth anymore.”

artists.name: Roost.World
artists.why: Live synthesizer sets — the answer when someone asks for anything that isn't folk or jam.

artists.name: Troy Millette & the Fire Below
artists.why: Sad yet upbeat folk songs about his exes, with tons of humour.

artists.name: The Wormdogs
artists.why: Best Band in the 2026 Seven Daysies. There is a phone hotline: (802) WORMDOG.

artists.name: Robber Robber
artists.why: The one with national traction. New album, Two Wheels Move The Soul.

artists.name: Lily Seabird
artists.why: Named in the same breath as Greg Freeman and Robber Robber, every time.

artists.name: Dari Bay
artists.why: Robber Robber's drummer's project. The newest solo record is the one people press on you.

artists.name: Old North End
artists.why: Named ONE. The band posts in the threads themselves.

artists.name: All Night Boogie Band
artists.why: “All Night Boogie Band never let me down.” Had the Nectar's Wednesday residency.

artists.name: Burning Monk
artists.why: Rage Against the Machine tribute. Locals argue about whether they count as local; consensus is yes.

artists.name: The Edd
artists.why: Named across four threads with no elaboration — the mark of an assumed-known band.

artists.name: Brunch
artists.why: “I work on these guys' guitars and they are absolutely decent humans with great talent.”

artists.name: Greaseface
artists.why: On constant rotation for the people who name it.

artists.name: Vallory Falls
artists.why: Members post in threads looking for shows.

artists.name: Clive
artists.why: “clive all day all night.” Phish and Zappa in a blender, and the guitarist just rips.

artists.name: Forest Station
artists.why: At the top of the Vermont bluegrass scene.

artists.name: Milton Busker & the Grim Work
artists.why: Suit-folk. “If you like Noah Kahan and diving deeper into lyrics — that's your VT band.”

artists.name: Cricket Blue
artists.why: “Taylor and Laura are amazing people and so talented.”

artists.name: The Bubs
artists.why: “Some of the most fun shows I've been to.” Start with Make a Mess.

artists.name: The Tenderbellies
artists.why: “As good as I've experienced, so good.”

artists.name: Seth Yacovone
artists.why: “One of the greatest guitarists and most soulful musicians you'll find anywhere.”

artists.name: Bob Wagner
artists.why: Recommended as a person, not a band: “Rough Francis and anything Bob Wagner is involved in.”

artists.name: LaMP
artists.why: Lawton, Metzger and Paczkowski. Best Jam Band Other Than Phish.

artists.name: Kat Wright
artists.why: The voice of a hundred Burlington summer nights.

artists.name: Rangus
artists.why: “A bunch of folks in the Rangus crew are in various other bands around here.”

artists.name: Fisher Wagg
artists.why: “Fisher Wagg just put out my favorite song of the year.”

artists.name: Phantom Suns
artists.why: “Killer band!”

artists.name: Wild Leek River
artists.why: “Rootin' tootin' boot scootin' good time.” Honky Tonk Tuesday regulars.

artists.name: Ponyhustle
artists.why: Best Country Band in the 2026 Chrisanthemums.

artists.name: Soule Monde
artists.why: Russ Lawton and Ray Paczkowski, as a duo.

artists.name: Reid Parsons

artists.name: Three Piece Meal
artists.why: “Funky jazz project. Very cool.”

artists.name: Dwight & Nicole
